description: This file is a shell script that manages boot configuration, specifically reading and writing the boot number in a persistent partition for the device. It defines a function mstc_rw_bootnum to perform these operations, utilizing external functions and utilities.

methods.name: mstc_rw_bootnum
methods.description: Reads or writes the 'bootnum' value in the 'persist' partition based on input parameter. Supports setting the value to 1 or 2, or reading the current value.

calls: printf "\x$setval" | dd of=$mtd bs=1 seek=4 conv=notrunc
